name: Alert
purpose: An in-flow status callout that interrupts nothing: it sits inside the page or form it refers to and stays until resolved or dismissed. The Mono successor to the Legacy Notifications 'contextual' placement — tinted RAG surface, full 1px accent border, status glyph, title + description + optional inline link + optional dismiss. Use Toast for transient confirmations and Banner for page-level persistent messages; use inline field validation (Input-fields) for single-control errors.

props.name: status
props.$note: Binds the R-D20 rag/{status} + rag/{status}-tint pair. Error renders role="alert" (assertive); the rest role="status" (polite).

props.name: title
props.$note: Optional bold lead-in (.t-ed-body .em, weight 500). Sentence case.

props.name: link
props.$note: Optional inline action link — descriptive text, never 'click here' (aca-004).

props.name: dismissible
props.$note: Adds the 24px × in a 44px hit target. Static alerts persist with the task.

variants.name: error
variants.use: Something failed and needs the user's attention now; assertive announcement.

variants.name: warning
variants.use: Caution or approaching deadline; amber surface always carries a near-black mark (R-D3).

variants.name: success
variants.use: In-flow confirmation that persists (contrast with Toast's transient success).

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class — message .t-ed-body (16/24); title emphasis .t-ed-body .em (500)
tokens.text: text/default on every tint (13.3–17.5:1 both modes)
tokens.dismiss: colour-only states pending button-family partial injection (ADR-0013); hover/active = currentColor mixes at 10%/16%
tokens.motion: component-type/button-family/{press-travel,press-darken} bound for the pending partial; dismiss collapse honours prefers-reduced-motion
tokens.$roundel: Light marks: error = tint knockout (4.71) · warning = near-black (5.76, R-D3) · success/information = white (5.0/5.03 — knockouts fail the 4.5 mark leg). Dark = white shape + black mark (2026-07-02 ruling, structural). Warning shape-vs-tint (2.44) exempt from the 3:1 shape leg by R-D3/R-D6 A′ convention.

motion.dismiss: max-height/opacity collapse 300ms; removed from the DOM on transitionend.
motion.reducedMotion: All transitions collapse to .01ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

responsive.rule: Fluid to its container; icon and dismiss anchor to the FIRST text line (24px boxes matching the .t-ed-body line box) and hold position as copy wraps. Verified to 300px via the demo width slider (1.4.10).

accessibility.role: role="alert" for error (assertive); role="status" for warning/success/information (polite).
accessibility.name: Dismiss control carries aria-label="Dismiss alert"; status glyphs are aria-hidden (title text carries the meaning — colour never the sole channel, icon-013).
accessibility.keyboard: Link and dismiss are in tab order; Enter/Space activate; dismiss removes the alert and does not trap focus.
accessibility.focus: Visible :focus-visible outlines on link and dismiss (2px currentColor).
accessibility.target: Dismiss hit area 44×44 via ::before although the visual control is 24px (2.5.8).
accessibility.nonText: Status shape ≥3:1 vs tint (error 4.71 / success 4.11 / information 3.85; amber exempt per R-D3/R-D6 A′); internal mark ≥4.5 vs shape in both modes.

antiPatterns: Colour as the only status channel (glyph shape + title text are mandatory companions)
role="alert" on non-error statuses (assertive interruptions for polite news)
Auto-dismissing an error alert (errors persist until resolved or dismissed by the user)
Re-implementing press physics locally on the dismiss control (ADR-0013 ratchet)
Hardcoding RAG hexes instead of the rag/* roles (Legacy-leak gate class)
Stacking an alert and a toast carrying the same message

tokenValidation.result: PASS — all bound vars match resolved light+dark; declared contrast pairs text ≥13.3:1, ui ≥3.62:1 both modes. Warning ui pair undeclared by convention (R-D3/R-D6 A′ exemption, noted in manifest $note).
tokenValidation.$note: Built Phase-2 wave 1 (worker B). Dismiss control awaits button-family $members registration (conductor) — empty AUTO-PARTIAL pair in place; colour-only states meanwhile.
